prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1156; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the left side, the left quarter panel shows a crease with paint loss, and the tail lamp assembly has a broken housing. Most of this damage lines up well with the impact that was described, and the pattern on the panels runs in a consistent direction. The proposed plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and lamp assembly, repairing and refinishing the quarter panel, and recalibrating the parking sensors. The labor hours requested fit the scope of these repairs, and the parts list shows no duplicated line items. Nothing in the records suggests earlier damage to this vehicle in the same areas.
